fact: SADCAS accredited the Eswatini Standards Authority's certification services (QMS-CERT 005, issue 3 of 25 November 2025) for quality management systems certification only, under ISO/IEC 17021-1 and 17021-3, with no information security scope.
title: Certificate of Accreditation: Eswatini Standards Authority - Certification Services
publisher: Southern African Development Community Accreditation Service (SADCAS)
